opportunities.name: Account brief email from SEC, Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a given company ticker, look up latest 10-K filing date on SEC EDGAR, get HQ, employees and CEO from Wikipedia, then draft an 'Account brief' email to dana@example.com.
steps: Search ticker on SEC EDGAR and open the company
Filter filings by Form 10-K Annual report and note latest filing date
Search company name on Wikipedia and open the article
Read HQ, employee count, CEO from infobox
Open mail compose, To dana@example.com
Subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Body: '<Company>: HQ <city>, <employees> employees, CEO <name>. Latest 10-K filed <date>.'
Discard/send draft

instances.values: SNOW / Snowflake, HQ Menlo Park, 9,060 employees, 10-K 2026-03-20
DDOG / Datadog, HQ New York City, 8,100 employees, 10-K 2026-02-18

opportunities.name: Supplier quote currency comparison email
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quotes in different currencies to USD on Xe, check supplier city local time on timeanddate, and email procurement the cheaper option.
steps: Open Xe currency converter
Enter amount A and currency A, convert to USD
Enter amount B and currency B, convert to USD
Open timeanddate, search supplier city, read current time
Compose email to procurement@example.com with subject 'Quotes: <item>'
Body: amounts, USD equivalents, cheaper currency, supplier local time
Discard/send

instances.values: 12500 EUR vs 1950000 JPY, Osaka, CNC enclosures
8200 GBP vs 780000 INR, Pune, Shipping boxes
third round in progress: 64000 INR / 14500 CNY conversions

opportunities.name: Timezone and holiday sync email
opportunities.description: For two cities, find time difference on timeanddate's converter and holidays in a country for a month, then email ops a sync note.
steps: Open Time Zone Converter
Add city 1 and city 2
Read time difference
Open Calendar > Holidays, choose country and month
Note holiday dates to avoid
Compose email to ops@example.com, subject 'Sync: <city1> / <city2>, <month>'
Body: difference and dates to avoid
Discard/send

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, October, avoid Oct 2 and 20
New York / Berlin, December, avoid Dec 25 and 26
